data.title: Feelings — Starter · Lesson 4
data.subject: feelings
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Here we go...

[Hook]
Happy… Feliz
Bored… Aburrido
I feel confused… Me siento confundido
Come on now, let’s sing it.

[Verse]
Cooking dinner, stirring the pot,
I’m feeling all sorts of things, you know it’s a lot.
I am very agitated… Estoy muy agitado
Stirring the sauce, keep it flavored.
I feel nostalgic… Me siento nostálgico
Remembering when we cooked together, side by side.
Full of energy… Estoy lleno de energía
Chopping veggies, feeling so alive.

[Hook]
Happy… Feliz
Bored… Aburrido
I feel confused… Me siento confundido
Come on now, let’s sing it.

[Verse]
Feeling uncomfortable… Me siento incómodo
The heat’s too much, but I’m pushing through.
Anxious for the party… Estoy ansioso por la fiesta
Waiting for friends to come through.
I feel relieved… Me siento aliviado
The food’s ready, and I did it right.
Full of hope… Estoy lleno de esperanza
Tonight’s gonna be a beautiful night.

[Bridge]
Cooking in the kitchen, singing all the while,

vocab.en: I am anxious for the party
